rb: Rb is a soft silvery metallic element of the alkali metal group.
Rb means the same as rubidium or atomic number 37.
rbc: RBC is a mature blood cell that contains hemoglobin to carry oxygen to the bodily tissues.
RBC means the same as red blood cell or erythrocyte.
rbi: A rbi is a run that is the result of the batter's performance.
For example: "He had more than 100 rbi last season."
Rbi means the same as run batted in.
